name: cstack
description: Map dependencies, analyze project stacks, and run coding jobs with the cStack controller.

interface.shortDescription: Code maps, stack analysis and checked fixes
interface.longDescription: Map Python, JavaScript and TypeScript file imports; identify technology stack declarations with file evidence; inspect Python/Node error frames; verify a change made by any agent or workflow before it is called done; and run one controlled Codex repair worker with independent sandboxed checks against the project's own installed dependencies and explicit review gates.
defaultPrompt: Use cStack to fix this bug and independently check the result.
